newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Oct 24-industry output up 4.8 pct - paper.
newsitem.headline: Indian Oct 24-industry output up 4.8 pct - paper.

text.p: India's 24-sector industrial production index rose 4.8 percent in October over the same month in 1995, the Observer newspaper said on Wednesday.
The growth rate during the first seven months of the 1996/97 (April-March) financial year was 4.8 percent compared with the same period in 1995/96, the daily said.
Between April and October 1995, the growth rate was 12.1 percent compared with the same period in 1994, it said.
The index includes 24 sectors accounting for 50.4 percent of the overall index of industrial production.
Officials at the Industry Ministry, which publishes the monthly figures, could not be reached for comment.
